name: AdvocacyActionCentre
tagline: Every supporter's voice moderated, delivered and answered – campaign by campaign, target by target.
description: A complete advocacy app for nonprofits in one Power Platform control: campaigns with goals, deadlines and projections; petition signatures, emails, letters, calls and meeting requests to decision makers; a moderation queue with blocked words, duplicate detection and a constituent check; consolidated delivery packs per target; response and stance tracking with follow-up SLAs; a status board and a delivery file export.
features: Campaign pages with goal progress, deadline countdown and on-track projection
Moderation queue: blocked words, possible duplicates, missing targets and the constituent (district) check
Consolidated delivery packs per target with action counts, districts and supporter quotes (names shortened, postcodes optional)
Delivery SLA and follow-up SLA with late flags in every view
Response logging with target stance (supportive → opposed) and a stance history per target
Workflow Received → Verified → Ready to deliver → Delivered → Response logged with Flagged, Duplicate and Rejected side tracks
Kanban board with drag-and-drop and keyboard Move menu
Bulk approve, ready, deliver and flag; delivery file CSV; undo
DeliveryText and CampaignSummaryJson outputs for Power Automate
Demo mode with 280 fictional actions, 5 campaigns and 12 targets
